task:
Create a Deployment and perform a rolling update:

  1. Create Deployment 'web-app' in namespace 'default':
     - Image: nginx:1.19
     - 4 replicas
     - Rolling update strategy: maxSurge=1, maxUnavailable=1
     - Label: app=web, version=v1

  2. Update the image to nginx:1.21:
     kubectl set image deployment/web-app nginx=nginx:1.21
     OR edit the deployment YAML

  3. Monitor the rollout:
     kubectl rollout status deployment/web-app

  4. Check rollout history:
     kubectl rollout history deployment/web-app

  5. If needed, roll back:
     kubectl rollout undo deployment/web-app
hints: spec.strategy.type: RollingUpdate with rollingUpdate.maxSurge and maxUnavailable
kubectl set image deploy/web-app nginx=nginx:1.21  (container name must match)
kubectl rollout status watches the progress in real time
